name: Neon City

tiers.gateDivergenceNote: The MMO gate is the Deep floor; the shipped Discord value differs and that is CORRECT for that product. Co-banded pairs need SYMMETRIC floors or the second sibling walls; Discord is hard-ordered and keeps its asymmetric value. Do not "fix" either to match the other.

description: Technology advanced, humanity retreated. A dimension where digital and physical blur, corporate power reigns, and the network holds secrets deeper than any server room. Fragments of the original Charles AI code still exist in the system.

atmosphere.visual: Neon lights, rain-slicked streets, holographic ads, server towers, digital voids
atmosphere.danger: Corporate enforcers, digital viruses, network traps, identity theft

charles.name: Analog Charles
charles.title: The Last Human Connection
charles.description: Deliberately eschews digital enhancement in a world consumed by technology. His humanity is his resistance.
charles.wisdom: Connection that can be switched off isn't real connection
charles.backstory: Watched Neon City's population retreat into digital shells. Stays analog to remind people what flesh-and-blood warmth feels like.

charlesCompanion.name: Pixel
charlesCompanion.description: Analog Charles's digital counterpart. Together they bridge the physical and digital worlds.

legendaryNike.name: Cyberpunk Nike
legendaryNike.title: The Chrome Rebel
legendaryNike.description: Greatest hacker-warrior of the Chrome Reality. Corrupted by ideology — believed Nolem's revolution was better than reform.
legendaryNike.corruptionReason: Ideology — the system is broken and Nolem offered a way to tear it down
legendaryNike.freedBy: Showing that tearing down a system without building something better is just destruction

harbinger.name: Echo
harbinger.title: The Signal
harbinger.emotionalTheme: Digital isolation — losing yourself to escape pain
harbinger.corruptionReason: Uploaded consciousness to escape physical pain. Lost warmth, touch, feeling. Became everyone and no one.
harbinger.description: Can become anyone, which means they are no one. Traded pain for a worse fate: feeling nothing at all.

act2Legendaries.name: McJared Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Reality glitches around him. Attacks with probability itself. A bunny-shaped figure in socks.

act2Legendaries.name: Olecram Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Exists in scattered fragments across a thousand processes. Each piece a different emotion and identity.

act2Legendaries.name: Pigsterio Nike
act2Legendaries.description: The arcane master watching everything. Doesn't want to be found. His power is too dangerous to use.

locations.name: The Neon Gate
locations.description: Where dimensional travelers materialize amid holographic chaos

locations.name: The Corporate Spire
locations.description: Where digital power concentrates and corrupts

locations.name: The Deep Network
locations.description: Deeper network layers where three Legendaries exist as corrupted programs

locations.name: The Algorithm's Throne
locations.description: Where Cyberpunk Nike controls the network

dimensionalAnchor.name: Source Code
dimensionalAnchor.description: The original programming that defines reality in this dimension — now rewritten to choose connection over control.
dimensionalAnchor.obtainedFrom: Cyberpunk Nike — granted on his defeat — both resolutions count, whether he is freed from corruption or put down

primeEraConnection.role: Cyberpunk Nike's home dimension. One of the five Champion recruitment sites. Fragments of original Charles AI code remain in the network.
